 CORAM: HONOURABLE MR. JUSTICE RAJIV ROY  ORAL ORDER 3 13-02-2024 Heard Mr. Ashish Giri, learned Counsel for the petitioners and Mr. Vinay Kumar Mishra, learned A.C. to A.A.G.-15.
2.
The present petition has been preferred for the following reliefs:-
(i) to hold and declare the entire acquisition proceeding bearing Case No.13/84-85 Patna High Court CWJC No.7680 of 2016(3) dt.13-02-2024 for 1.3725 acre of land in village-Muzaffara, Thana No. - 443, District-Begusarai as instituted by the respondent State in relation to the properties of the petitioners concern to have been lapsed in terms of Section 24(2) of the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency Shambhu Nath Mahto And Ors vs The State Of Bihar And Ors on 13 February, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/60163333/
2 in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act,2013;
(ii) to hold and declare the entire acquisition proceeding bearing Case No.13/84-85 as instituted by the respondent State in relation to the properties of the petitioners concern to have been lapsed also in light of Section 11A of the Land Acquisition Act,
1894 as no award has been made uptil now since passing of the notification of publication in the year 1985 and declaration in the year 1986;
(iii) to hold and declare that in light of Section 17(3-A) of the Land Acquisition Act,
1894, taking of the possession of the property of the petitioners without tendering payment of 80 percentum of the compensation is illegal and Patna High Court CWJC No.7680 of 2016(3) dt.13-02-2024 therefore no possession in the eyes of law.
(iv) to issue an appropriate writv/order/direction in the nature of Mandamus directing the respondent authorities to provide the cost of acquisition as define under Section 3(1) of the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013 as the respondent State has already constructed the road on the acquired property of the petitioners without making any award and without payment of any compensation thereafter;
(v) to issue an appropriate writ/order/direction in the nature of Mandamus directing the respondent authorities to pass an award under the new Act on the basis of the current market value of the lands in question in light of the provisions of the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013 and compensate the petitioners accordingly;
(vi) to issue an appropriate Patna High Court CWJC No.7680 of 2016(3)
dt.13-02-2024 writ/order/direction in the nature of Mandamus directing the respondent authorities to also award solatium as per Section 30 of the new Act,
interest @ 15% in light of Section 80 of the new Act read with Section 34 of the erstwhile Land Acquisition Act, 1894.
